submission.natural_language_explanation: This negative pole carries no specific semantic, syntactic, or upcoming-token feature: it emits a weak, broadly tuned background response (range 0 to ~0.17, top-20 peaks spanning only 0.1677-0.1700) on most non-initial tokens, slightly higher on frequent function words and subwords, driven almost entirely by the current token (63% of attribution, mean distance 0.9). It therefore does not predict activity better than common-token base rates; any ordinary sentence and matched subword soup both reach the same ~0.17 ceiling, the Jacobian lens is Gaussian (kurtosis 3.10) with incoherent promoted tokens, and no minimal edit produces more than a ~0.01 fractional change.
